units.rawText: Hoh, my first encounter with you, Professor? I snuck up behind you and aimed my extinguisher right at your neck... Uh... Professor, why are you giving me that look?

units.rawText: You pulled a brilliant prank indeed, but from what I can recall through my blurry memory... Chelsea, you didn't play any pranks before you joined the Oasis.

units.rawText: I'd even say you were more of a… workaholic? You went straight into rescuing other members right after we saved you from the Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Ugh! I really don't want to hear you, of all people, say I'm a workaholic... I was desperate at that time. My first awakening was in the Baltimore Fire Department, and I experienced losing my home for the first time after we were severed from the real world.

units.rawText: I wasn't myself back then... anxious, lonely, and sometimes just staring at my extinguisher, letting it sit idle for an entire day.

units.rawText: Every time I felt uneasy, you were there for me; chatting and offering comfort. Even with how busy you were, you always made time for me.

units.rawText: As this routine continued, I couldn't help but wonder how I could help you relax in return. So, I decided to pull one of my good ol' pranks... but I didn't think it would go so wrong.
